notes: Run of 2026-11-27. Two SF YIMBY stories queued, both published: building permits for Block B of the former CPMC California campus at 3700 California Street, and a pre-application proposal for a six-story building at 3101 Buchanan Street.

findings.description: Building permits filed over recent months for Block B of the former California Pacific Medical Center campus: two eight-story apartment buildings (B1, 214 units, the full California Street frontage from Cherry to Maple; B2, 36 units at Sacramento and Maple) and nine four-story single-family houses on Sacramento, 261 units in all, about $130 million. A proposal: nothing goes in building.

citation.label: San Francisco YIMBY, “New Building Permits For Portion of California Pacific Medical Center Redevelopment, San Francisco,” 27 November 2026

raw.text: New building permits have been filed for a portion of the California Pacific Medical Center redevelopment master plan at 3700 California Avenue

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 3700 CALIFORNIA ST → parcel 1016002; sf-parcels has blklot 1016002 active, 3700–3750 CALIFORNIA; the 2025 roll records it as commercial misc, built 1965. EAS puts 3700, 3740, 3750 CALIFORNIA ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 3700.

publish.note: Existing page (no seeding); headline entry added to historical_record and the homepage grid. Proposal: no building fields.

findings.description: A Project Review Meeting request proposes replacing the two-story corner building (one apartment over a small grocery) with a six-story, 65-foot building of four condominiums under the Housing Choice legislation. Preliminary application not yet submitted. A proposal: nothing goes in building. The owner named in the article is a private individual and is not recorded.
